name: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch Wagyu Cheeseburger & Peach Cobbler
brandOrRestaurant: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
searchKeywords: garden city wagyu burger peach cobbler
whyItWorks: Tender local Wagyu beef burger on a soft brioche bun with aged white cheddar is a solid dinner at Conestoga Ranch when ordered without bacon-onion jam or arugula.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Wagyu Burger medium-well on brioche with white cheddar only (skip raw onion/arugula) and blot excess grease; if ordering the Dutch Oven Peach Cobbler, skip the vanilla ice cream or take lactase.
watchOuts: Wagyu beef has higher intramuscular fat marbling—order medium-well so excess fat renders off
